description: The eval tenant's model policy per mode, and the named deterministic samples a slow mode runs. A sample narrows only by stable keys (the documented origin scenarios first, then scenario-id hash order), so the same sample is the same questions on every run.

nollm.note: No model anywhere: extraction, consolidation and every read are deterministic.

llm.note: The tenant's model policy as the live stack runs it: every use but the opt-in memory_restatement, reads assisted, one gateway model.

harness.note: Memory deterministic (as nollm); the wrapped agent's model answers through the gateway.

llm.note: Per capability the InventorySmart origin scenario plus the first scenario of every other domain (hash order); three phrasing kinds; English. Scale (capability 7) is left out: extracting its ~1,100-message tenant with a CPU model takes hours - it is measured in nollm and harness mode.

harness.note: Per capability the InventorySmart origin scenario plus the first scenario of every other domain; the direct phrasing; English.

smoke.note: One scenario per capability, one phrasing: a minute, to see the pipeline work.

core.note: The PR gate (make eval-capabilities-isolated MODE=nollm SET=core): every capability but scale, every language and the code-switched phrasings, every phrasing kind, every surface; its own baseline (nollm/core). On the isolated store the worker's queues hold only the run's own work, so it asks once all of it - summaries and graph enrichment included - has drained (bounded at 15 minutes; about 4 minutes in practice).

scale.note: Capability 7 alone, every language: run in the PR of a change that targets it, and in the nightly full run. Held to the full nollm baseline's scale cells; its latency is not compared.

llm_core.note: The llm-mode PR gate (make eval-capabilities-isolated MODE=llm SET=llm_core): a fixed stratified subset of core small enough to index through a CPU model in about an hour (697 turns, 326 phrasings per surface). Per capability (scale aside): the InventorySmart origin scenario and, of the scenarios in another domain, the one with the fewest turns (ties: id-hash order) - all five domains appear; every language and the code-switched phrasings; three phrasing kinds (direct, paraphrase, implicit). The list is fixed here, so the set does not move when scenarios are added.
